Sprout Pod.notes: Singular item name and five-count requirement clear despite other quest-field disagreements. Stack size, binding, value and tooltip unknown.

Sprite Essence.notes: Item name and eight-count requirement agree between accounts embedded in archive, which are not independent confirmations. Numeric drop chance, binding, value and stack size unknown.

sources.title: Gloves of Foreststalking | VGOPlayers Item Detail

Gloves of Foreststalking.notes: Direct record preferred: required level 6 is separate from item level 16. Archive main stats instead show dexterity 2, hit points 8 and energy 8. Direct page shows No Trade, Unique, Soulbound; binding trigger unknown. Unlabelled 160 not treated as a price. Race restrictions and client icon need later capture. Reward association is an archive loot-table label, not proof of an NPC combat drop.

Entrepreneur Nargix.notes: General goods vendor role documented. Items, prices and buying restrictions are unknown; null inventory must not become an empty in-game inventory.

Tracker Lorhu.notes: Map point identifies camp, not a verified exact spawn. Quest page instead gives -7119, -66671, 3606. Difficulty 2 dots documented; race, gender, combat values and respawn unknown.

Tracker Nok.notes: Exact spawn unknown; multiple quest pages give -22572, 88588, 553, far from the camp map point. Difficulty 2 dots; race and combat values unknown. Infiltrating And Investigating is also listed but not collected in this batch.

Entrepreneur Nargix.notes: Zone page labels general goods vendor; not assumed to be an exact in-game title. Difficulty 4 dots. Race, combat values and exact spawn unknown; stock not recorded in inspected pages.

Wildgrowth Forest.notes: Range describes mobs, not player requirements. Zone map lists bindstones at 80593, 51139; -3482, -64746; 21588, 4228, with unspecified axis order and no height. Riftway name not captured. New archive compilation, not a dated historical snapshot.
